main.intro: I'm Yurier Herrera, a software engineer and entrepreneur.{space} I design and build digital products with an obsession for user experience, and I apply artificial intelligence and automation to transform processes.{space} I taught Software Engineering and Project Management, and I'm open to collaborating with companies and entrepreneurs on new products and solutions.
main.visitor: Hi Yurier, show me what you do.
main.ready: Of course. Start with my projects or writings, or open the message dock to ask about anything else. {links}
main.about: I'm Yurier Herrera, a software engineer and entrepreneur. I taught Software Engineering and Project Management at the Universidad de las Ciencias Informáticas, and today I design and build digital products with a strong obsession for user experience.{space} I combine technical excellence (Django, REST APIs, web and mobile) with project management (SCRUM, PMBOK), and I apply artificial intelligence and automation to transform processes in companies and organizations. I'm open to collaborating with companies and other entrepreneurs on new solutions and products.{space} Access other pages directly: {links}

tool.hobbies:
Outside of programming and my technical projects, I dedicate much of my free time to my passions: sports, music, traveling, and spending time with friends. Sports teach me discipline and perseverance, music fuels my creativity, and traveling opens me up to new cultures and ways of thinking, which also nurtures my intellectual curiosity.
These passions help me maintain balance and strengthen the qualities I bring to both my studies and my career: curiosity, commitment, autonomy, and a constant desire to improve. They make me someone who is motivated, adaptable, and always ready to take on new challenges.

Each stage has strengthened my technical and management skills across very different environments.
